units.source_text: 玉鬘的侍女的衫袖及一般装饰，即使与过惯高贵的宫廷生活的宫人们相比较，也显得很入时。

en.t: The sleeves and general adornments of Tamakazura's attendants looked stylish even when compared with ladies used to refined court life.

units.source_text: 色彩及式样尽管与别人相同，但看来总觉得特别华丽。

en.t: Although the colors and styles were the same as everyone else's, they somehow appeared especially splendid.

units.source_text: 玉鬘与众侍女都觉得此间欢乐，想多留几日。

en.t: Tamakazura and all her attendants found the place delightful and wanted to stay a few more days.

units.source_text: 犒赏踏歌人的礼品，照例各处相同，但玉鬘这里所赠的棉絮特别富有风趣，式样与众不同。

en.t: The gifts given to reward the kagura dancers were usually the same everywhere, but the cotton wadding offered at Tamakazura's quarters was especially tasteful and distinctive in style.

units.source_text: 这里是踏歌人休憩之所，光景非常热闹，人心更添喜气。

en.t: This was the place where the dancers rested, and the scene was very lively, adding even more cheer to everyone's spirits.

units.source_text: 招待踏歌人的酒筵本有定规，但今天办得特别精致。

en.t: The banquet for entertaining the dancers normally followed fixed rules, but today it had been prepared with special elegance.

units.source_text: 这是髭黑大将所指示的。

en.t: This had been arranged at the instruction of General Higekuro.

units.source_text: 他也住在宫中的值宿所内，这一天几次三番派人去对尚侍说：

en.t: He too was staying in his night-duty quarters at the palace, and that day he repeatedly sent messengers to tell the Naishi no Kami:
Please be sure to return to your own residence tonight.

units.source_text: 深恐际此时机，君将变心。

en.t: I greatly fear that at a moment like this your heart may change.

units.source_text: 入宫任职，教人甚不放心也。”

en.t: Your entering palace service makes me very uneasy.

units.source_text: 反复说了数遍，玉鬘置之不答。

en.t: He repeated this several times, but Tamakazura ignored it and gave no reply.

units.source_text: “太政大臣叮嘱：‘难得入宫，不可匆忙辞去。

en.t: The Chancellor has instructed us, 'Since she has finally entered the palace, she must not leave in haste.

units.source_text: 须使皇上喜悦，得其许可，然后退出。’

en.t: She should please His Majesty, obtain his permission, and only then withdraw.'
It would be far too early for her to leave tonight.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将懊丧之极，说道：“我如此反复劝请，还是不能随心所欲，奈何！”

en.t: General Higekuro was utterly disheartened and said, "Even after pleading so many times, I still cannot have things as I wish; what am I to do?"
He went on grieving without end.
